summary: The stated certificate bounds, annular-collapse implication, two-block counterexample, and finite-truncation assertions are proved without mathematical errors or gaps. Small-dimensional, centered-shift, tied-nearest-point, zero-cutoff, zero-eta, and threshold-boundary cases do not refute the claims. Corollary 3.2 and its unit-Gaussian normalization were checked in the primary source at https://arxiv.org/html/1502.04796v3#S3; the candidate's linear transformation and covariance comparison have the correct direction and scaling. The proxy lower bound is uniform over the entire interval 0 < b < 2 before the infimum is taken. The dimension-weighted theta and moment errors establish the strict eventual separation between the proxy and the second energy moment, so Gamma_3 collapses to Gamma_1. The oriented cancellation-vector count, divergent genuine-score lower bound, residual asymptotics, and endpoint-retention radii all agree with the statement. The proof keeps the vanishing certificates untruncated and makes no invalid inference about weak Oertel.
